'''2008 Worlds Team Noah DS Carbon Chamber Testing''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Noah]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Team Tournament). Incomplete first name as written. Sheet title Junk. Team Deck Wreckers. Shield block blank on sheet.


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Noah]]
* '''Event:''' [[2008 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Carbon Chamber Testing / Your Fantasy Made Real|Carbon Chamber Testing]]
* '''Stage:''' Team Tournament
